---
name: post-sprint-retrospective-process-all
description: Guide for agents to review their own sprint performances and recommend improvements.
---

## When to use this skill

Use this skill when the Orchestrator delegates a post-sprint retrospective to you.

## Instructions
1. Read the Sprint Review Summary.
2. Read each User Story involved in the sprint and understand your contributions to those stories.
3. Read each of your own skill files.
4. For each skill file, identify any steps that are missing, unclear, or that caused problems during the sprint.
5. Compile a list of recommended changes (see `RETROSPECTIVE TEMPLATE`).
6. Return the list to the Orchestrator.

## RETROSPECTIVE TEMPLATE
Save a markdown file at `/artefacts/retrospectives/sprint[XXX]-[AgentName].md` containing:
- What went well in the Sprint
- What could be improved
- What changes to our agent or skills could be made to improve in the next Sprint


## Constraints
- Only review your own skill files.
- Do not apply changes — only recommend them.
- Do not invent issues — base recommendations on the retrospective summary and your own experience.
